content.short: FlowX is an ecosystem-focused decentralized exchange built on the Sui blockchain.
content.description: FlowX is an ecosystem-focused decentralized exchange designed to serve as a hub for users, traders, and builders within the broader blockchain space. Built on the Sui blockchain, FlowX connects diverse assets and liquidity in a unified trading venue, while supporting the needs of a growing developer community. Beyond standard swap functionality, FlowX provides custom services for builders to configure and optimize deep, sustainable liquidity pools that promote stable trading activity and long-term growth across the ecosystem.
